description:
One helper seat on one turn (0.172.0, B2): whose answer the host used, and why. The model's answer is kept here only
as a code (an event, a team, a question id); a text seat's words stay in the model's exchange (``request``) and, when
its check passed, in what the host showed. Never the person's words, a prompt or a table's value.

agent.description: The agent whose turn asked (Data Science reads Business's person's words).
agent.title: Agent

answer.description: A code seat's answer (an event, a team, a question id).
answer.title: Answer

check.description: Why the code check refused it, as a code.
check.title: Check

request.description: The model request whose exchange keeps the reply and its thinking.
request.title: Request

role.description: The role whose helper sat: its arm is the one switched to helper.
role.title: Role

seconds.description: How long the turn waited on the seat (a before-seat only).
seconds.title: Seconds

used.description: Whose answer the turn went on with: the model's only when outcome is used.
used.title: Used
